question: On high-|omega| seed 28 (tight tube), does cluster-disappearance discriminate, and does the truth-lineage tag track spatial truth?
hypothesis: Cluster-disappearance is real on a fast tumbler with a tight tube, and the truth-lineage tag follows real truth.
narrative_md: Threading on high-|omega| seed 28 (anchor t=312, tube/truth ratio 1.04) yields two opposite-sign findings. (1) Cluster-disappearance IS real: 5/19 clusters die right, 8/19 die left by step 20, deaths clustering at brightness-extreme epochs (0.12% retention) -- the mechanism is validated. (2) BUT the truth-lineage tag decouples from spatial truth: random uniform tube sampling makes truth-cluster descendants wander >=150 deg from real truth while other lineages track it. The lineage tag is NOT a reliable proxy for following truth -- fix is to sample (q_a, omega) PAIRS and propagate as fixed trajectories. Tracks truth-cluster lineage (truth read as input).
